bug.title: The live authoring prompt never carries available_streams, so the model requests streams the snapshot does not hold and every such signal returns a constant vector
bug.symptoms: SignalContract.declaration(snapshot=...) can report available_streams (bug_spec_authoring_contract.xml bug 1), but _authoring_prompt.py builds the prompt's contract section with signal_contract().declaration() and passes no snapshot (line ~247). _llm_author.py has no snapshot to hand it. The live prompt therefore never says which streams exist, and the model chose 1h bars and borrow data, which this snapshot lacks.
bug.reproduction_steps: Compose the signal author with NULLIUS_EVALUATION_CONFIG naming a snapshot holding only 1d bars, and build one root prompt: its contract section has no available_streams key.
bug.expected: - The composed signal author resolves the evaluation context's sealed snapshot from NULLIUS_EVALUATION_CONFIG (the same snapshot the evaluator mounts). It reads only the manifest and no Parquet files, so composition stays cheap. Every root, child and retry prompt's contract section then carries available_streams. - When available_streams is present, the contract section also states plainly that every accessor or frequency not listed returns an empty frame for this evaluation, so a signal must be built from the listed streams only, and the theme must be expressed through them. The statement is generated from available_streams, never hard-coded to "1d bars". - Without NULLIUS_EVALUATION_CONFIG, the prompt is unchanged. A configured snapshot that cannot be read refuses composition with the existing EvaluationConfigError text rather than silently omitting the field. - test_prompt_available_streams.py covers the root, child and retry prompts over a tmp sealed snapshot with only 1d bars: each carries available_streams == {"bars": ("1d",)} and the empty-frame statement. No config gives no field. A broken snapshot path refuses. Zero Parquet reads at composition. No network, and it passes under pytest-xdist.
bug.actual: Root cause: the snapshot argument added to declaration() was never threaded through the prompt builder or the composed author.
bug.constraints: signal-agent may add the snapshot workspace member to its pyproject dependencies (and regenerate uv.lock with `uv lock`) to read the manifest through snapshot's public API; it does not import orchestrator No file outside the five listed is edited Do not edit docs/user-journeys/
